company.name: AdKraft AI
company.shortDescription: AI-native creative platform for video advertising — from brief to finished film, with built-in competitor and ad intelligence.
company.description: AdKraft.ai is a full-stack, AI-native creative platform for video advertising. It spans strategy, production, and intelligence in one workflow: turn a creative brief into campaign themes, ad ideas, storylines, storyboards, characters, and a finished multi-scene film; reframe, upscale, and localize to 160+ languages; and run competitor reverse-engineering, ad-impact prediction, and brand perception. Free HD Quick Ads with no card; paid plans add the full campaign builder and intelligence suite.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Angel round raised $200,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,200,000 to $3,200,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 92 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 81 (+78).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
